reading.title: Assessing just access to urban ecosystem services through spatial multi-criteria decision modeling: Evidence from a Global South city, Dhaka
reading.why: It links urban ecosystem service supply and spatial accessibility with social justice indicators in a Global South city.
questions: How did the authors model 15-minute walking access?
What weight did social vulnerability receive in the index?
Does the justice framework account for informal areas?
reading.check: The abstract does not detail the exact mathematical weighting used to combine these disparate indicators.

coverage: Evidence is limited to recent news headlines and a single case study on Dhaka. There is no explicit coverage of Kabul, and informal settlement applicability is noted as missing in the paper.
